svg.aria-label: A quantity is an exact magnitude plus a unit id. A unit table resolves the id to a dimension and a conversion path. An operation first type-checks the units; mismatched dimensions are ill-typed and consume nothing. Otherwise it is evaluated under a meter and ends as completed (a value plus any loss record), undefined, refused or incomplete.
